# Receipt Cycle: full content for AI systems

> Receipt Cycle is a web and Android app for freelancers, independent professionals, and small businesses. It captures receipts with AI extraction and keeps expenses, customers, estimates, invoices, payment records, budgets, and reports connected in one workspace.

Source: https://receiptcycle.com/ | Last updated: 2026-10-19 | Contact: support@receiptcycle.com
This file is generated from the same content as the public pages. The page URLs below are canonical.

## Product overview

Receipt Cycle (trade name of TempEmailGen) helps freelancers, independent professionals, and small businesses keep the records behind everyday spending and customer billing in one place.
It is available as a web app and an Android app that share one account. No iOS app is published.

Features:
- Receipt capture with AI extraction of merchant, date, total, tax, and line items
- Expense and income records with categories, accounts, and notes
- Customer records and a reusable products and services catalog
- Estimates and invoices with tax, discounts, and payment terms
- Payment records, balances, and payment receipts
- Monthly category budgets compared with recorded spending
- Income, expense, cash flow, and overdue invoice reports
- Ask AI questions about saved records
- CSV transaction export on paid plans

What it is not:
- Receipt Cycle is not a full accounting system: no general ledger, payroll, inventory, or tax filing.
- It records payments received through other methods. It is not a payment gateway and does not collect customer funds.
- It does not give accounting, tax, legal, or investment advice. AI output must be checked against the saved records.
- No iOS app is published.

## How it works

1. Capture: photograph or upload a receipt, or enter a transaction by hand. AI proposes the merchant, date, total, tax, and line items, and you review them before saving.
2. Organize: saved transactions get categories and accounts. Customers and a catalog of products and services are stored for billing.
3. Bill: prepare estimates, convert accepted work into invoices, and record full or partial payments with receipts.
4. Review: compare monthly category budgets with recorded spending, open reports, and ask questions about the saved records.

## Pricing

Source: https://receiptcycle.com/pricing

- Free: $0. 7-day trial with Pro-style features; up to 25 transactions during trial (all entry types). No CSV export on Free.
- Pro Monthly: $3.50 per month with a 7-day free trial. Unlimited transactions, receipt scan, upload and manual entry, budgets, full edit access, CSV export.
- Pro Yearly: $35 per year with a 7-day free trial. Everything in Pro Monthly.
- Pro Lifetime: $60 one time, launch offer. Everything in Pro Monthly with no monthly charges.
- Prices are in USD. Payments are processed by Polar, which acts as merchant of record. Monthly and yearly plans can be cancelled from the account.

## Feature pages

### Invoice Software for Small Businesses

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/invoice-software | Last updated: 2026-09-28

Create professional invoices, add customers and line items, review totals, track payment status, and record payments with Receipt Cycle invoice software.

Covers:
- Invoice line items
- Tax and discount calculations
- Invoice preview
- Invoice status and balances
- Full and partial payment records
- Payment receipts

Questions and answers:

**Is Receipt Cycle a full accounting system?**
No. Receipt Cycle covers everyday money tasks like invoices, estimates, payments, receipts, expenses, budgets and reports. It does not replace payroll, tax filing, inventory or a full general ledger system.

**Can I add tax, discounts, notes, and payment terms?**
Yes. The invoice builder lets you add tax and discount percentages, notes, payment terms, issue and due dates, quantities, rates and line item descriptions.

**Can I record a partial payment?**
Yes. Enter the amount you received and how it was paid. Receipt Cycle updates the paid amount, the balance left, the invoice status and the payment history.

**Does Receipt Cycle process online card payments?**
No, not right now. Receipt Cycle records payments you got through your own payment method. It is not a payment gateway.

**Can I print or save an invoice as a PDF?**
Yes. Open the invoice preview and choose print. Your browser can print it or save it as a PDF.

**Can I turn an estimate into an invoice?**
Yes. You can turn an estimate into an invoice draft you can still edit. The customer, line items, tax, discount and terms come with it.

**Does Receipt Cycle include invoice templates?**
Not a gallery of templates. Receipt Cycle gives you one consistent invoice layout that uses your business details and accent color.

### Estimate and Quotation Software

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/estimate-quotation-software | Last updated: 2026-09-29

Create detailed estimates and quotations, track approval status, and convert accepted work into an editable invoice with Receipt Cycle estimate software.

Covers:
- Estimate and quotation creation
- Products and service line items
- Quantity and rate calculations
- Tax and discount calculations
- Estimate validity dates
- Draft, sent, accepted, and expired status
- Estimate preview and sharing
- Accepted estimate conversion to invoice draft

Questions and answers:

**What is the difference between an estimate and a quotation?**
Not much. Many businesses use estimate, quote and quotation for the same document, sent before the work starts. The name often depends on where you are and how fixed the price is. In Receipt Cycle you write one estimate with the proposed work, price, how long it is valid, and terms.

**What can I include in a Receipt Cycle estimate?**
Pick a customer, add products or services with descriptions, quantities and rates, then set tax, a discount, notes, terms, an issue date and how long the estimate is valid. Check the total before you save or send it.

**Can I preview and send an estimate?**
Yes. You can preview an estimate and then send or share it. Sharing hands the document to your phone or email app. There is no automatic tracking of whether the email was opened, and no approval portal.

**Which estimate statuses are available?**
Draft, sent, accepted and expired. There is no rejected status yet.

**Can I convert an accepted estimate into an invoice?**
Yes. Convert it into an invoice draft you can edit. The customer, line items, quantities, rates, tax, discount and terms carry over, so you can check the invoice before you send it.

**Is this contractor estimating software?**
It can work for contractors who quote set services and rates. It is not built for construction takeoffs, materials databases, job costing, tenders or project scheduling.

**Does Receipt Cycle work as estimate and invoice software?**
Yes. Estimates and invoices work together. Send the estimate first, turn accepted work into a draft invoice, then handle billing in the invoice workspace.

### Payment Tracking and Receipt Management Software

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/payment-tracking-software | Last updated: 2026-09-29

Record full or partial invoice payments, update balances, preserve payment history, and create shareable receipts with Receipt Cycle payment tracking software.

Covers:
- Full and partial invoice payment records
- Paid amount and outstanding balance updates
- Payment method, date, account, and reference
- Invoice payment history
- Numbered payment receipts
- Receipt preview
- PDF and image receipt sharing on supported mobile devices
- Print or save as PDF on the web workspace

Questions and answers:

**What does payment tracking software do?**
It records customer payments against invoices, so you can see the date, amount, method, reference, payment history, paid amount and balance left in one place. Receipt Cycle also creates a receipt once a payment is saved.

**Can I record a partial payment?**
Yes. Enter any amount up to the invoice balance. Receipt Cycle adds it to the payment history, updates the paid amount and balance, and marks the invoice partially paid until the full total is recorded.

**Does Receipt Cycle process customer payments?**
No. Receipt Cycle only records payments you received by bank transfer, card, cash, mobile money or another method. It does not collect money, work as a payment gateway or check that funds have arrived.

**What information appears on a payment receipt?**
A receipt can show the business, customer, receipt number, invoice reference, amount received, payment method, receiving account, payment date, payment reference and the balance left.

**Can I preview, download, or share a receipt?**
Yes. On mobile you can preview a receipt and share it as a PDF or image through your phone apps. On the web you can share it, print it or save it as a PDF.

**Does Receipt Cycle support payment reconciliation?**
Only by hand. Each recorded payment stays attached to its invoice, reference, method, date and balance, so you can match it yourself. There is no automatic bank feed matching.

**Is this accounts receivable tracking software?**
It covers the everyday accounts receivable jobs of a small business: invoice status, paid amounts, partial payments, overdue balances, payment history and receipts. It is not built for enterprise collections or treasury work.

### AI Receipt Scanner

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/ai-receipt-scanner | Last updated: 2026-09-30

Scan receipt images, extract merchant, amount, date, tax and line items, review the details, and save organized expense records with Receipt Cycle.

Covers:
- Mobile receipt camera with flash control
- Receipt image upload from mobile gallery or web
- Merchant, amount, date, time, and payment method extraction
- Subtotal, tax, currency, and line-item extraction when visible
- Suggested expense category
- OCR confidence, detected language, and review tags
- Editable review before saving an expense
- Receipt evidence connected to saved transaction records

Questions and answers:

**What does an AI receipt scanner extract?**
It can suggest the merchant, total, date, time, payment method, category, currency, subtotal, tax, document type, language, confidence, tags, receipt text and line items, when they are visible. Results depend on the image, so always review them.

**Can I scan a receipt with my phone camera?**
Yes. The mobile app has a receipt camera with a flash control, or you can pick an existing photo from your gallery. On the web, you can upload supported receipt images.

**Can I edit the OCR result?**
Yes. The review screen is there for corrections. Check the merchant, amount, date, time, category, payment method, text and any line items before you save the expense.

**Does the scanner always capture tax and line items?**
No. Tax and line items only come through if they are visible and readable on the receipt. A short, faded, folded, handwritten or damaged receipt may give fewer fields or a lower confidence score.

**Can I use the receipt scanner for taxes?**
You can use it to keep your receipt images and checked expense details organized for later. Receipt Cycle does not decide deductions, file returns, give tax advice or promise that a record will satisfy a tax authority or audit.

**Does Receipt Cycle support multilingual receipts?**
It is built to recognize several writing systems and can show the language it detected. Accuracy still depends on image quality, fonts, handwriting, layout and the OCR service available at the time of the scan.

**Can I scan PDF receipts?**
The receipt camera and image upload are meant for image formats like JPG and PNG. Importing a PDF statement is a separate upload and does not use receipt camera OCR.

### Business Travel Expense Tracker

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/business-travel-expense-tracker | Last updated: 2026-09-30

Capture travel receipts, record airfare, hotel, meals and transportation, filter trip expenses, and export organized transaction records with Receipt Cycle.

Covers:
- Receipt camera, gallery selection, and supported web image upload
- Manual travel expense entry
- Editable merchant, amount, date, category, payment method, account, and notes
- Receipt evidence connected to transaction records when available
- Search by merchant, description, category, and amount
- Filters for date range, category, account, and transaction type
- Cash, card, bank, and savings account activity
- CSV transaction export when plan and workspace access permit

Questions and answers:

**What can I record with a business travel expense tracker?**
You can record things like flights, hotels, meals, local transport, parking, fuel, event fees, internet access and trip supplies when they are for work. Each transaction can hold an amount, merchant, category, date, payment method, linked account, notes and the receipt if you have one.

**Can I scan travel receipts while I am away?**
Yes. Use the mobile receipt camera or pick a photo from your gallery, then check the details before saving. You can also upload a receipt image on the web, or type in the purchase if you have no usable image.

**Can I group expenses under a trip name?**
Not yet. Receipt Cycle has no trip name field. Use travel dates, categories, the linked account, merchant search and notes to find the right records. It does not handle itineraries or bookings.

**Does Receipt Cycle create a business trip expense report?**
You get transaction history, date and category filters, report totals and CSV export where your plan and workspace allow it. There is no formatted PDF expense report for a single trip.

**Does it handle expense claims and employee reimbursement?**
No. Receipt Cycle can organize the records behind a claim or reimbursement, but it is not travel expense claims software. It does not submit claims, send them to managers for approval, enforce travel policy or repay employees.

**Can a corporate or small team use it for travel expenses?**
A team can use shared categories, accounts, notes, receipts and exports to keep better records. Receipt Cycle is not built for corporate booking, card feeds or enterprise travel and expense management.

**Does Receipt Cycle reconcile travel expenses automatically?**
No. Business travel expense reconciliation is something you check yourself. Filters, accounts, payment methods, notes and receipt attachments help you compare records, but Receipt Cycle does not match card feeds, settle cash advances or approve differences.

**Can I export my travel transaction records?**
Yes, as CSV, when your plan and administrator settings allow it. The file has fields like date, type, category, amount, merchant, description, payment method and workspace. There is no PDF travel report export.

### Freelancer Tax & Receipt Tracker

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/freelancer-tax-receipt-tracker | Last updated: 2026-10-01

Capture freelancer receipts, organize business expenses, review records by date and category, and export transaction data for tax preparation with Receipt Cycle.

Covers:
- Receipt camera, gallery selection, and supported web image upload
- Editable merchant, amount, date, category, payment method, account, tax, and notes
- Receipt evidence connected to saved transactions when available
- Manual expense and income entry
- Search by merchant, description, category, and amount
- Filters for date range, category, account, transaction type, and sort order
- Category-aware reports and income-and-expense totals
- CSV transaction export when plan and administrator access permit

Questions and answers:

**What does a freelancer tax tracker do?**
It helps you capture receipts, record business expenses, review transaction details, sort categories, search by date range and export supported transaction data. It gets your records ready for review. It does not work out your return, file taxes or decide what counts as deductible.

**Can I scan tax receipts with my phone?**
Yes. The mobile app can capture a receipt with the camera or from your gallery, and the web workspace accepts compatible image uploads. OCR can suggest the purchase details, so check every field before you save the expense.

**Does Receipt Cycle decide which expenses are tax deductions?**
No. Receipt Cycle does not decide what you can deduct. Categories, notes, receipts and transaction history help you show the facts, but you or a qualified tax professional decide how an expense is treated.

**Can I use it as a receipt tracker for taxes throughout the year?**
Yes. Save records as you buy things, then review them weekly or monthly. That gives you a much better starting point than rebuilding the year from paper, email and card statements at filing time.

**Can I organize both expenses and income?**
Yes. Receipt Cycle handles both expense and income transactions, and reports and totals give you the wider picture. It does not calculate taxable income, estimated payments or tax owed.

**Can I give my accountant a CSV export?**
Yes, when your plan and administrator settings allow it. The file can include date, type, category, amount, merchant, description, payment method and workspace. Check what is in the export and ask your accountant what else they need.

**Does the CSV include every receipt image?**
No. A CSV is a file of transaction data, not receipt images. The images stay with the saved transaction, so plan how you will share them with your accountant.

**Does Receipt Cycle replace tax software or an accountant?**
No. Receipt Cycle is a place to organize your records. It does not prepare or file tax forms, give legal or accounting advice, guarantee compliance, calculate savings or replace the professional who handles your taxes.

### Business Budgeting & Expense Planning

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/business-budgeting-software | Last updated: 2026-10-01

Set monthly category budgets, compare recorded spending with each limit, and review the transactions behind your progress with Receipt Cycle.

Covers:
- Monthly category budget limits
- Total budget, recorded spending, and remaining summaries
- Category-level budget versus actual comparison
- Percentage-used and monthly progress views
- Recent expense transactions within each category
- Month navigation and editable budget limits
- Over-budget states when recorded spending exceeds a limit

Questions and answers:

**What does business budgeting software do in Receipt Cycle?**
It lets you pick a month, set a limit for each expense category, compare it with what you spent, and see what is left. Open a category to see its progress and recent transactions, so every total has a source you can check.

**Can I create a different category budget for each month?**
Yes. Each budget belongs to a month and a category. Switch months to plan a new one or look back at an old one. Changing one month does not change the others.

**How is budget versus actual spending calculated?**
The budget is the limit you enter for a category. Actual spending is the total of your saved expenses in that category for the month. Receipt Cycle compares the two and shows what is left for every category that has a budget.

**What happens when a category goes over budget?**
The amount left goes negative and the category shows as over its limit. It is a signal for you to review, not a block. Receipt Cycle does not decline purchases, control cards or approve expenses.

**Does the business budgeting app send budget alerts?**
No alerts are promised. The budgeting workspace shows progress, percent used, amount left and over-budget status when you open it. There are no automatic budget alerts, email warnings or push notifications.

**Can I see which purchases used a category budget?**
Yes. Open a category to see its recent expenses for the month. The merchant or description, date and amount connect the progress bar to the records behind it.

**Is this business financial planning software?**
It helps you plan and watch monthly spending. It is not a forecasting tool, cash flow scenario model, general ledger, payroll system, tax planner or enterprise financial planning platform.

**Can I use Receipt Cycle instead of a spreadsheet?**
For monthly category limits and actual spending, yes. A spreadsheet may still be better for forecasts, staffing plans or scenarios Receipt Cycle does not cover. Use each tool for what it does well.

### Client & Customer Management for Invoicing

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/client-management-software | Last updated: 2026-10-01

Keep customer details, invoice history, outstanding balances, and reusable products or services connected with Receipt Cycle client management software.

Covers:
- Searchable customer profiles
- Contact and billing information
- Customer status and internal notes
- Connected invoice history
- Invoice count and outstanding balance
- Reusable products and services catalog
- Catalog descriptions, categories, unit prices, and active state

Questions and answers:

**What is client management software for small business?**
It is software that keeps your client details and the work around each client in one place. In Receipt Cycle that means contact and billing details, status, notes, invoice count, balance owed and linked documents. It is built around billing, not a full sales CRM.

**Can I keep customer contact information in Receipt Cycle?**
Yes. A customer record can hold a contact name, company, email, phone number, billing address, status and private notes. You can edit it when things change and search by customer, company or email.

**Does each customer record show invoice history?**
Yes. Invoices are linked to the customer, so you can see invoice numbers, due dates, status, totals, invoice count and how much is still owed. Estimates, invoices and payments are still handled in their own workspaces.

**Can I save services and prices for later invoices?**
Yes. The Items & Services catalog stores a name, description, category, unit price, type and active status. Pick them when you build an estimate or invoice so you do not retype common work.

**Is Receipt Cycle a customer database software product?**
It gives you a simple customer directory for billing work. It works if you need searchable customer records linked to your sales documents and balances. It is not a database builder, a marketing tool or an enterprise customer data platform.

**Does Receipt Cycle replace a CRM?**
No. Receipt Cycle has no lead scoring, sales pipelines, campaign automation, call logging, email-open tracking or sales forecasting. Use it when you mainly want customer details next to your estimates, invoices, payments and saved billing items.

**Can freelancers use the client management app?**
Yes. For freelancers, client management is usually simple: keep the right billing address, jot a note, find old invoices and reuse a service price. Receipt Cycle does that without a complicated sales process.

**Can I track outstanding balances by customer?**
Yes. The customer directory works out each balance from the linked invoices and recorded payments. Open a customer to see the invoices behind the number. Recording payments and receipts is covered on the payment tracking page.

### Expense Reports & Financial Reporting

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/expense-reporting-software | Last updated: 2026-10-01

Review income, expenses, category spending, cash flow, payments, and overdue invoices with Receipt Cycle expense report software for small business.

Covers:
- Monthly and all-time income and expense summaries
- Net movement and transaction-count reporting
- Expense distribution by category
- Six-month and current-year cash-flow views
- Payments received and paid-invoice counts
- Outstanding and overdue invoice reporting
- Record-grounded AI-assisted analysis
- Supported CSV transaction export

Questions and answers:

**What does Receipt Cycle expense report software show?**
It adds up your saved income and expenses for the period you pick. You see income, expenses, what is left over, record count, spending by category, cash flow comparisons, payments received, paid invoices, unpaid invoices and overdue invoices, where you have those records.

**Can I review monthly income and expense reports?**
Yes. The main report can show this month or all your records. The cash flow report compares the last six months or this year with monthly income and expense bars, total money in, total money out and net cash flow.

**Does the expense reporting app show category spending?**
Yes. Receipt Cycle groups your saved expenses by category, works out each category total and transaction count, and shows your biggest categories. Open the transaction workspace to fix a category or check a single record.

**Can it report on invoices and payments?**
Yes. The report dashboard shows unpaid invoice value, payments received and the number of paid invoices. A separate overdue view shows the overdue amount, invoice count, average days overdue, customer, balance and due status. You still record payments in the payment workflow.

**Does Receipt Cycle create automated expense reports?**
Partly. Totals and charts update by themselves from your saved records for the period you pick, so you do not rebuild summaries by hand. Receipt Cycle does not submit employee claims, route approvals, reimburse people, email reports on a schedule or file anything automatically.

**Can I export a business expense report?**
Yes, as CSV, on supported plans and workspaces. Use it in a spreadsheet or share it with a professional. It is transaction data, not a tax return, an official financial statement, a PDF claim packet or a bundle of receipt images.

**What can the AI analysis do with my reports?**
It uses a limited set of your saved transaction fields to answer questions about category totals, merchant patterns, changes between periods, recurring charges, possible duplicate entries and unusual patterns, and to give plain-language summaries. It does not change your records or make regulated financial decisions.

**Is this financial reporting software for small business accounting?**
It gives you everyday reports on your saved transactions and linked sales records. It has no general ledger, balance sheet, official profit and loss statement, bank reconciliation, payroll, inventory accounting, audit assurance or automatic tax filing.

### AI Financial Assistant and AI Expense Analysis

URL: https://receiptcycle.com/ai-financial-assistant | Last updated: 2026-10-01

Ask questions about spending, categories, merchants, income, expenses, and financial trends using Receipt Cycle AI analysis grounded in saved business records.

Covers:
- Typed financial questions grounded in saved records
- Supported microphone input
- Income and expense comparison
- Expense category totals and ordering
- Merchant pattern summaries
- Plain-language business activity recaps
- Possible recurring, similar, and unusual entry review
- Source-record verification without automatic edits

Questions and answers:

**What is an AI financial assistant?**
It is a tool that lets you ask plain questions about your financial data. In Receipt Cycle, Ask AI works from a limited view of your saved transactions. It can repeat totals, rank categories, describe merchant patterns, compare activity across periods and give a short recap. It cannot change your records or make financial decisions.

**What records can Receipt Cycle use for AI expense analysis?**
It can use saved transaction fields like date, amount, type, category, merchant and description, where you have them. It also gets totals such as transaction count, income, expenses and top expense categories. Each question uses a limited slice of your data, not everything in the workspace.

**Can I ask a question by voice?**
Yes, in supported browsers. Receipt Cycle turns your spoken question into text and sends it to Ask AI. You can also just type. Voice needs microphone permission, a signed-in account, plan access and an available service.

**Can the AI find duplicate or recurring expenses?**
It can flag possible patterns: entries that look alike, repeat at the same merchant, share an amount on nearby dates, or stand out from your other expenses. These are not confirmed duplicates or bad charges. Check each one against the saved entry and, if needed, the receipt or statement.

**Is Receipt Cycle an AI bookkeeping assistant?**
Not on its own. Receipt Cycle can organize and summarize the records you save, which can help with a bookkeeping review. It does not keep your books for you, reconcile bank accounts, post journal entries, prepare official statements, pick accounting treatment or file taxes. A bookkeeper or accountant still does that work.

**Does the assistant provide financial or tax advice?**
No. The assistant only gives neutral summaries of your own logged data. It does not give accounting, tax, legal, investment, debt or personal money advice. It also does not tell you to cut spending, cancel a service or invest.

**Will Ask AI change my transaction records?**
No. Ask AI gives you an answer. It does not edit amounts, dates, categories, merchants, descriptions or transaction types. If a question points to a problem, open the record, check the evidence and fix it yourself.

**How is this different from an AI financial dashboard?**
A dashboard shows fixed totals and charts. Ask AI lets you ask questions about your records in plain words. Receipt Cycle also has report views for categories, cash flow, payments and invoice aging. Use those for repeatable expense reports, and use AI expense reporting questions when you want a plain-language explanation or a new angle.

## Frequently asked questions

Source: https://receiptcycle.com/faq

**Can I use Receipt Cycle on both the web and Android?**
Yes. You can use Receipt Cycle in a web browser and in the Android app. Sign in with the same account and your records show up in both.

**Do I need a credit card to create an account?**
No. You can create an account and start with the free access without entering a card. If you pick a paid plan later, the pricing page shows the billing options and what each plan includes before you pay.

**What types of records can I manage?**
You can manage receipt images, expense and income transactions, customers, products and services, estimates, invoices, payments, budgets and financial reports. Some features depend on your plan and workspace settings.

**How does AI receipt scanning work?**
You take a photo of a receipt or upload one. Receipt Cycle then tries to read the merchant, date, total, tax and line items. Check what it found against the image before you save it.

**Can I create estimates and convert accepted work into an invoice?**
Yes. You can write an estimate with customer details, line items, quantities, rates, taxes, discounts, notes and an expiry date. Where conversion is available, the accepted estimate carries over into an invoice, so you do not start from scratch.

**Can I record partial payments and outstanding balances?**
Yes. You can record the amount, date, method and reference of each payment against an invoice. The payment history and remaining balance show whether the invoice is unpaid, partly paid or paid in full.

**Does Receipt Cycle process customer payments?**
No, not unless your account shows a payment option. Receipt Cycle records payments and invoice balances. It is not a payment gateway or merchant processor. Make sure you have actually received the money before you record it.

**Can Receipt Cycle help with business budgets?**
Yes. You can set spending limits for categories and months, then compare them with what you have recorded. A budget is only as accurate as the transactions you have saved.

**What can I ask the AI financial assistant?**
You can ask about the activity saved in your workspace, such as spending by category or how this month compares with last month. AI answers can be incomplete or wrong, so check important ones against your transactions and reports.

**Is Receipt Cycle a replacement for an accountant or tax professional?**
No. Receipt Cycle helps you organize your finance records and get them ready for review. It does not give accounting, tax, investment or legal advice, and it does not replace a qualified professional who knows your location and situation.

**Where is my information stored?**
Your account and workspace information is stored with the service providers and backend systems set up for Receipt Cycle. The privacy policy explains what information is involved, why it is used, and how providers protect it.

**Can I correct or delete a record?**
Yes, you can review and correct most records from the screen they live on. If you want your account or data deleted and cannot do it yourself, email support@receiptcycle.com. We may ask you to verify your identity.

**Can I export my information?**
You can export some records, and the options can vary by plan. Check the report or settings screen to see which formats your account has before you send an export to an accountant or use it for an audit or tax filing.

**What happens if receipt scanning or synchronization is interrupted?**
Keep the original receipt until you can see the image and its details in your workspace. A bad connection, an unsupported image format, a blurry photo or service maintenance can slow down uploading, scanning or syncing.

**How do I get help with my account?**
Use the contact form, or email support@receiptcycle.com from the address linked to your account. Please do not send passwords, full card numbers, ID numbers or other sensitive details in your message.

## Home page questions

Source: https://receiptcycle.com/

**What can I do with Receipt Cycle?**
You can scan receipts, track expenses, keep customer details, send estimates and invoices, record payments, set budgets, view reports, and ask questions about your saved records.

**Is Receipt Cycle a complete accounting system?**
No. Receipt Cycle is a simple place for your spending, customer billing and business records. It does not replace a full accounting system, an accountant or tax advice.

**Can I use the same account on mobile and web?**
Yes. Capture things on your phone, then use the web workspace when you want a bigger screen for documents, budgets or reports.

**What does the AI do?**
It helps read receipt details and answers questions about the activity you have saved. You stay in charge of every correction, category and business decision.

**Do I need a credit card to get started?**
No. You can create an account without a card. If you upgrade later, the pricing page shows the current plans.
